column1: # C->Lua event fire sites of the 1.12.1 client (build 5875): every call and tail-jmp to
# printf-style arg_format). eventId is resolved via 1.12-event-catalog.tsv; "dyn" = computed
# (e.g. a UnitField update loop); a blank name = the id has no entry in the name table.
# arg_format is the format string the site pushes: a declaration, not a census of what the
# caller pushed. The marshaller 0x704f10 consumes one vararg per directive (%f eight bytes,
# everything else four), so a format that declares more than its caller pushed hands Lua
# undefined values. Of the 149 SignalEvent2 sites exactly three do: 0x496230
# TRADE_REPLACE_ENCHANT "%s%s%d" declares 3 and pushes 2; 0x5e4527 and 0x5e7960 UPDATE_TICKET
# "%d%s%f%f%f%d%d" declare 10 dwords and push 7 (their sibling 0x5e45e2 pushes the full 12).
# Every other site's format matches its caller.
# The name column resolves every id through the in-game table (0xbe1198, 549 entries). 0x703d90
# is called twice with different populations, 0x46a88f with (0xb41e70, 26) for the glue phase
# and 0x48feab with (0xbe1198, 549) for the world, and rebuilds [0xceef68] wholesale from
# whichever it is handed, so the same integer names a different event in the two phases, and
# 0x703e50 bounds-checks nothing. 22 rows here sit in a `Source\Glue\` TU (0x46aa34;
# 0x46bc9d-0x46c52e inside 0x46b930; 0x46e73d; 0x47461e): their ids belong to the glue space and
# are never named from 1.12-event-catalog.tsv; their names are blank here. 0x46aa34 fires id 22,
# which is FRAMES_LOADED in the glue table (GlueParent.lua:94), not the in-game UNIT_MAXHEALTH.
# An event with no row here is not an event with no producer. This covers the two signal
# helpers' own call/jmp sites, and the per-field UNIT_* family reaches them through a wrapper:
# 0x515e50(&guid, id) fans out over the unit tokens and fires 0x703f50(id, "%s", token) at
# 0x515e7a, the "?" row below. Its 38 callers carry the id in edx; one of them, 0x51bd5b in the
# UpdateField watch callback 0x51bd50, computes it as (registered field byte offset >> 2), so
# ids 0x00-0xb5 (every named unit descriptor field, UNIT_FLAGS 40 included) are produced there
# and appear nowhere in this file. 0x51bd50 is the sole producer of 40; its fire condition is a
# repe cmpsb of the watched span against the object's shadow, at 0x4655bb. Most other
# 0x515e50 sites carry a literal id in edx, absent here too at any magnitude: {0x10 0x16 0x1c
# PLAYER_FLAGS_CHANGED (0x5eea35 mov edx,0x197 / 0x5eea3d call 0x515e50, inside the
# PLAYER_FLAGS delta handler 0x5ee990) lies outside 0x00-0xb5 and still has a producer. Same
